title: Application Insights & KQL for AI Telemetry
description: Instrument .NET AI applications with Azure Application Insights, telemetry initializers, and write advanced Kusto (KQL) queries for anomaly detection.

data.text: Deep Observability with Azure Application Insights

Application Insights is Azure's application performance monitoring (APM) platform. In generative AI applications, traditional HTTP request monitoring alone is insufficient. You need to capture dependency durations for external model calls, correlate database retrieval steps, record prompt token consumption, and query aggregated telemetry using Kusto Query Language (KQL) to triage production anomalies.
Enriching Telemetry with ITelemetryInitializer in C#

Telemetry initializers run on every captured trace, dependency, and request, allowing you to automatically stamp AI-specific metadata (TenantId, ModelDeployment, Environment) across all telemetry items without modifying individual controller methods.

data.text: Kusto Query Language (KQL) powers Azure Monitor logs. Use KQL to detect latency bottlenecks, track token consumption spikes, and isolate failed LLM dependency calls.

data.title: KQL Query: Analyzing Slow AI Completions and 429 Errors
data.content: Calculates P95 latency and token consumption grouped by tenant over the last 24 hours:
data.code:
dependencies
| where target has "openai.azure.com"
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| extend TenantId = tostring(customDimensions.TenantId),
         TokensUsed = toint(customDimensions.TotalTokens)
| summarize 
    TotalCalls = count(),
    FailedCalls = countif(success == false),
    RateLimit429s = countif(resultCode == "429"),
    P50_Duration_ms = percentile(duration, 50),
    P95_Duration_ms = percentile(duration, 95),
    TotalTokens = sum(TokensUsed)
    by TenantId
| order by TotalTokens desc

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Application Insights provides end-to-end APM telemetry for .NET AI applications
Use ITelemetryInitializer to inject TenantId and AI metadata across all logs and dependencies
Track Azure OpenAI HTTP dependencies to measure remote inference latency and 429 throttle spikes
Write KQL queries in Azure Log Analytics to visualize token consumption trends by business unit
Set automated Azure Monitor alerts on P95 latency regressions and elevated failure rates
data.takeaway: Application Insights and KQL provide the observability lens for production AI, enabling .NET teams to diagnose latency bottlenecks and monitor token economics in real time.
